HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 51-year-old female admitted for upper GI bleed. Admission data:

Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Hypertension. Anemia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.68-0.72, hemoglobin 9.5-10.3, platelets 194-203, sodium 140, wbc 5.2-5.8; vitals dbp 75-80, heart_rate 80-85, map 91-96, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 121-129, spo2 96-97, temp 36.5-36.7
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Transfuse 1 unit packed red blood cells
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Hypertension. Anemia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 51-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Upper GI bleed. Hypertension. Anemia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
